the problem of cooperative multi agent reinforcement learning (MARL) in a CTDE setting.

the proposed method QR MIX is a novel method for cooperative multi agent reinforcement learning that is based on the quantile regression framework and can handle the randomness and monotonicity constraints of the joint state action value function.
our proposed model QR MIX outperformed the previous state of art method QMUX by a significant margin in the StarCraft II multi agent challenge environment.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we proposed QR MIX, which is a distributional version of QMIX and it outperforms QMIX on StarCraft Multi Agent Challenges (SMAC).
we proposed a novel model QR MIX to solve cooperative MARL problems with the CTDE setting.

we proposed QR MIX to solve CTDE problems by introducing quantile regression to model the distribution of joint state action values, and proposed a flexible loss to approximate the monotone property of QMIX.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the randomness in returns and observations should be considered in MARL and CTDE.
the quantile regression method can be combined with existing MARL methods to improve their performance in the CTDE setting.
we can model the distribution of long term returns in the CTDE setting and improve the robustness of the MARL system.
